kpis_story.description_fr: Annoncé Q2 2023, fusion Bunge-Viterra (Glencore agri) crée méga-trader $25Md combined revenue. Closing Q1-Q2 2025 sous conditions antitrust. Synergies ~$250M ciblées 3 ans.
kpis_story.description_en: Q2 2023 announced Bunge-Viterra (Glencore agri) merger creates mega-trader with $25B combined revenue. Q1-Q2 2025 closing pending antitrust. ~$250M synergies targeted over 3 years.
